scope: All tracked Rust, Python, PowerShell, shell, assembly source/tests; Cargo/workflow/skill metadata; plugin/hooks and schema contracts. Vendor dependencies, binaries, ignored caches and user runtime state excluded.
method: Full text read by root and three scoped readers; file hashes rechecked after reading.
claim_boundary: Reading coverage is not exhaustive correctness, execution evidence, semantic accuracy, or host enforcement.
hash_semantics: SHA-256 of observed Windows working-tree bytes; CRLF/LF may differ from canonical Git blobs.
